source_name: European Payments Council — SEPA scheme rulebooks & register of participants (MK adherents)
why_relevant: North Macedonia joined SEPA's geographical scope (EPC approval 6 March 2025; earliest operational readiness 5 October 2025). EPC rulebooks (SCT, SCT Inst) and the adherence register are the binding scheme rules and the authoritative list of which MK banks adhered and when.

source_name: European Commission — Enlargement/DG FISMA SEPA accession announcements
why_relevant: Official EU-side confirmation of MK banks entering SEPA schemes and the phased dates; useful for dating migration milestones that MK operators then implement.

source_name: Banca d'Italia TIPS Clone / Western Balkans instant payments programme
why_relevant: North Macedonia signed a letter of intent (Oct 2025) to join the Banca d'Italia-led TIPS Clone connecting WB6 payment systems to TARGET Instant Payment Settlement, with go-live targeted 2026. Programme documentation carries the cut-over timetable and participation criteria that will bind MK PSPs.

source_name: ClearingPost — MIPS North Macedonia infrastructure profile
why_relevant: Specialist trade analysis consolidating MIPS participant counts, SEPA accession and the TIPS Clone timeline — a useful cross-check and pointer to primary documents, though secondary and to be verified.

source_name: НБРСМ — Стратегија за развој на платниот систем (payment system development strategy)
why_relevant: Strategy document from the National Payment System Council setting the medium-term infrastructure agenda (instant payments, standards, interoperability) from which operator-level deadlines are derived.

source_name: НБРСМ — Споредете ги надоместоците за платежните услуги (fee comparison portal)
why_relevant: Mandated fee-comparison portal; indirectly reveals how scheme/clearing pricing and instant-payment rules propagate into bank tariffs, and is itself a compliance obligation with reporting deadlines for PSPs.

source_name: Bank general terms & conditions (Општи услови за платежна сметка и платежни услуги) — KB, Stopanska, CCBank, UNIBank etc.
why_relevant: Participant banks restate KIBS/MIPS cut-off times, instant-payment availability and scheme rules in their T&Cs, with explicit effective dates. Diffing successive editions is a reliable proxy for detecting unpublished scheme rule and cut-over changes.

source_name: ProCredit Bank MK blog — 'КИБС или МИПС плаќање, која е разликата'
why_relevant: Bank-authored explainer that states the operative thresholds and cut-offs distinguishing KIBS clearing from MIPS RTGS — a fast, plain-language cross-check on how scheme rules apply in practice.

source_name: Македонска берза / Централен депозитар за хартии од вредност — rules for membership & settlement
why_relevant: Adjacent infrastructure rule-setter: the exchange/CSD membership and settlement rules interoperate with MIPS for cash legs and are covered by the same NBRM oversight scheme map; relevant when tracking DvP settlement deadlines.

source_name: NBRNM — Register of payment system operators (EN)
why_relevant: English-language statutory register of licensed payment system operators (KIBS, CaSys, NBRNM-run systems etc.) — identifies the infrastructure layer that vendors and banks must integrate with.

source_name: НБРСМ — Банкарски систем на Северна Македонија (list of licensed banks & savings houses)
why_relevant: Page from which the downloadable list of banks and of savings houses holding an NBRNM operating licence is published; the canonical enumeration of obliged credit institutions.

source_name: НБРСМ — Штедилници (savings houses section)
why_relevant: Dedicated section listing licensed savings houses — a small but distinct supervised population that is often omitted from bank-only lists yet is fully obliged under payments/AML rules.

source_name: НБРСМ — Менувачници (exchange offices section / register of authorised exchange operators)
why_relevant: Register/section for licensed exchange offices (менувачници) — a large, high-churn supervised population and a frequent host of fast-money-transfer agency and cash-handling hardware.

source_name: НБРСМ — Трансакции брз трансфер на пари / fast money transfer providers section
why_relevant: NBRNM section covering fast-money-transfer (брз трансфер на пари) providers and their reporting; the statutory register of such providers is maintained under a dedicated Rulebook, making this the licence-status source for remittance agents.

source_name: Правилник за водење на регистарот на даватели на услуги брз трансфер на пари (dejure.mk consolidated)
why_relevant: The rulebook that defines what the fast-money-transfer provider register must contain and how it is kept — tells the collector exactly which fields to expect and when entries must be updated.

source_name: НБРСМ — Издавање дозволи и согласности за небанкарски даватели на платежни услуги, оператори на платни системи и менувачници (licensing page, EN)
why_relevant: Describes the licensing/approval procedures and requirements feeding all the non-bank registers; the natural place where new licence decisions and application guidance are announced.

source_name: Одлука за издавање дозволи и согласности на платежна институција и институција за електронски пари и за содржината и начинот на водење на регистрите
why_relevant: The NBRNM decision that legally constitutes the PI/EMI registers and prescribes their content and upkeep — the schema definition for the two most important registers in this cell.

source_name: Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (consolidated, NBRNM PDF)
why_relevant: Consolidated PSD2-aligned law (latest amendments per OG 144/25) creating the PI/EMI/PSO registers and defining the licensed categories the registers enumerate; anchor text for the whole cell.

source_name: НБРСМ — Листа на водечки броеви на банките (bank leading/BIC-style codes list, XLS)
why_relevant: Machine-readable XLS enumerating every bank with its payment-system leading number — the cleanest structured identifier list for joining bank entities across datasets, and it changes when banks enter/exit.

source_name: NBStat — преглед на депозитни институции (банки и штедилници)
why_relevant: PX-Web statistical portal whose deposit-institution tables implicitly track the population of banks and savings houses over time; useful to date entries/exits when the register itself is not archived.

source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ (Central Registry — trade/company register)
why_relevant: National company register; resolves every licensed PI/EMI/exchange office/agent to legal identity, ownership, address and annual accounts — the join key between the supervisory registers and corporate reality.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — Регистри (Ministry of Finance registers section)
why_relevant: MoF keeps registers for the non-NBRNM-supervised financial perimeter (notably финансиски друштва / financial companies and leasing), which are payments-adjacent obliged entities not covered by NBRNM registers.

source_name: Фонд за осигурување на депозити (Deposit Insurance Fund) — member institutions
why_relevant: All licensed banks, foreign bank branches and savings houses are compulsory members; the Fund's membership list is an independent cross-check on the NBRNM licence register and reacts fast to failures/exits.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (MBA) — members and sector notices
why_relevant: Industry association whose membership (all banks, savings houses, KIBS clearing house, Macedonian Credit Bureau) mirrors the supervised population and which publishes sector notices about licensing/continuity of exchange offices and fast-transfer providers.

source_name: sporedi.nbrm.mk — comparison portal of bank & savings-house products
why_relevant: NBRNM-run comparison site that lists every participating bank and savings house with product data; an implicit, frequently-refreshed roster of active licensed institutions and their retail offering.
